aspect: It is documented and it is not treated as an error
description: The TN statistician case in GAT-002 is one instance: refused, then approved on refiling with the same underlying facts. Inconsistency of this kind is not recorded as a defect in the system; it is absorbed as the ordinary operation of discretion.
energy_note: Two opposite correct decisions, and no contradiction anywhere.

aspect: Which converts the process into a lottery with an entry fee
description: If the outcome varies with the decision-maker, then reapplying is rational, and reapplying costs money. The system extracts a fee per attempt at a randomised outcome.
energy_note: Paying again for a different roll.

aspect: Only the well-advised know to try again
description: The applicant with a lawyer is told a refusal is not the end. The applicant without one believes an official decision means something. The variance therefore sorts by access to advice.
energy_note: The refusal is final for the people who believe it is.

aspect: SCENARIO - the two sisters at two windows
description: Same sponsor, same documents, same purpose, same day, adjacent counters. One is issued and one is refused for insufficient ties. There is no forum in which those two decisions can be placed side by side.
energy_note: Nowhere on earth can those two files be compared.
